title: Litigant cannot seek repeated adjournments, then blame lawyer for delay: Gauhati High Court
description: The Gauhati High Court recently held that litigants cannot repeatedly seek adjournments in a case and later shift the blame to their lawyers for delay in hearing the matter [Sayed Maqsud Ahmed v. Khurshid Ali Ahmed].
